title: Halloween Costume Party, 1954 B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A candid black and white snapshot captured on October 30, 1954, showing guests at a Halloween costume party. A woman wearing a homemade apron advertising Altes Golden Lager beer laughs while surrounded by guests dressed in sailor uniforms. Altes Brewing Company was a prominent Detroit, Michigan brewery during the mid-20th century, adding a localized mid-century advertising element to this festive holiday gathering.
